name: Adaptive Architecture — Employee experience
description: Build a professional but playful employee experience platform for a 500-person technology company. The marketing site should feel warm and energetic, while the application itself should feel professional, fast and trustworthy. Make the dashboard refined, make onboarding playful, keep settings conservative.

productModel.primaryAudience: Employees, team leads and people operations teams
productModel.primaryObjective: Help employees connect with their teams, complete onboarding, share feedback and access organisational policies
jobsToBeDone: Review the overview and priority actions
Welcome a colleague and complete onboarding milestones
Share a team pulse and recognise a colleague
Review organisational policies and notification preferences
